workshops.title: Kintsugi: Mending with Gold
workshops.blurb: Break a ceramic bowl on purpose, then mend it with gold. You take home your bowl and a starter kit.
workshops.includes: All materials, bowl, chai and snacks

workshops.title: Resin Coasters & Ocean Pours
workshops.blurb: Learn pigment mixing, cells and lacing, then pour a set of four coasters to collect once cured.

workshops.title: Arabic Calligraphy for Beginners
workshops.blurb: Hold a qalam, learn the Naskh alphabet and letter your own name on a small canvas.

workshops.title: Diwali Diya Painting for Parents & Kids
workshops.blurb: Paint and gild a set of six diyas together, just in time for Diwali.

workshops.title: Resin Geode Wall Clock
workshops.blurb: Design and pour a 30 cm geode-style clock with crushed glass and gold edging.
